papers.title: Next-Token Prediction Learns Generalisable Representations of Sleep Physiology
papers.what: Hypnos tokenizes eight physiological modalities with residual vector quantization and trains an autoregressive RQ-Transformer by next-token prediction, beating a dedicated ECG model at atrial-fibrillation detection.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025), MAE Theory (Zhang 2023), Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017)

papers.title: Personalized Deep Learning for Short-Term Forecasting of Impending Atrial Fibrillation from Continuous Wearable ECG Signals
papers.what: Per-patient fine-tuning of a global wearable-ECG model lifts impending-AF forecasting AUROC from 0.614 to 0.711 on ICENTIA11K, with gains that grow with adaptation data.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025), LLMs are Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023)

papers.title: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory
papers.what: MemoPilot trains an LLM agent's memory-update process with multi-turn GRPO, ranking first in Elo on Rock-Paper-Scissors and Limit Texas Hold'em over hand-designed memory rules.

papers.title: Where Should Knowledge Enter? A Layered Framework for Knowledge Infusion in Multimodal Iterative Generative Models
papers.what: A four-layer map (surface, trajectory, latent, parametric) for injecting knowledge into diffusion models cuts knowledge-violating outputs by 70.97% in a safety-alignment study.
